basic_profile.bio: Born and raised in the bustling city of Lyon, France, I am a 31-year-old language enthusiast working as a freelance translator. I have a passion for learning new languages and diving deep into linguistic nuances, which has led me to frequently contribute to language-related subreddits. I am currently based in Brighton, UK, where I moved a year ago to explore new opportunities and improve my English skills. I am single and enjoy spending my evenings online, mostly between 7 PM and midnight, local time. My disdain for misinformation is as strong as my love for good coffee and indie music. When I'm not working or online, you can find me exploring local cafes or attending poetry readings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Linguistics and have been self-teaching additional languages through online platforms and immersion since my teenage years. My professional experience as a translator for various international clients has further honed my linguistic skills. I also have a growing interest in internet culture and the dynamics of online communities.
